notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Changes
- improvement of the consistency for gesture based attacks
- longer tutorial level for better understanding of the game
- better description of the shop page
- fixed a bug, which didn't let you grab your hat

The game runs well. However since the bending system is complicated, I add this to the description of the game on the shop page.  Next time don't skip the tutorial, pls.

Some people may use gestures, which are not attacks, but still expect the enemy to fall over. The hitboxes always worked fine. I couldn't find a problem with that.

notes.title: End of early access
notes.notes: This update adds waterbending to the game.

notes.title: Primal Darkness Update
notes.notes:
Within the first act the sun god Ra was defeated.

The Primal Darkness used this opportunity and conquered the world.

Only you are the last hope for your goddess Gaia. 

Stand up against your fears and battle against your nightmares!

notes.title: Free Battlepass
notes.notes:
With this update there are several changes:

I added a free battlepass with several skins and even one new ability.

Furthermore I increased the performance of the game by a lot. 

As last point I changed Gaia, who was just a particle effect, into a human being.

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
[b]Quality of Life Changes:[/b]
- The Rotation of the hand, which breaks the stones only works on one axis now, which feels much more fitting for earthbending.
- Gaia (the one you have to defend) now changes the position according to the wave, so that you don't have to wait too long for you to lose, after you missed one enemy.
- The checkpoints now point with an arrow towards the enemy spawner, so that it is easier for new players to know, what is going on.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
- Physical Animation seemed to not work properly. Reworked the whole mechanic. It is now working properly.
